metaTitle: Custom SM Cooling Sport Towels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom SM cooling sport towels for your team or event. Perfect for outdoor workers and athletes. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: SM cooling sport towels offer rapid evaporative cooling for outdoor workers, athletes, and event attendees. These lightweight towels activate with a simple soak and wring, providing hours of relief without electricity or refrigeration. Ideal for construction crews, sports teams, and corporate giveaways, they can be customized with your logo through screen printing or heat transfer. Choose SM for reliable performance and quick turnaround on bulk orders.
heroAltText: Custom SM cooling sport towels with blue and white stripes, folded and stacked for bulk orders
